info.name: Smart Campus Platform
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Smart Campus Platform.

Getting started:
1. Start the backend (http://localhost:8080).
2. Run Auth > Login. The token is saved automatically into the jwtToken variable and every other request uses it.
3. Some requests are role-specific - re-run Login as faculty or Login as student to switch role.

Demo password for every seeded account: Demo@1234

request.description: Run this first. The test script saves the token into the jwtToken collection variable, which every other request uses.
No token needed - used by the registration form.
DEMO or BLE - the UI labels demo attendance from this.
Sign in as faculty first. Note the returned id for the next two requests.
Demo mode: the faculty screen sends the student id.
BLE mode (ATTENDANCE_MODE=ble): a scanned advertisement with its signal strength.
Writes ABSENT for every student in the class who was never detected.
Role-aware: a student sees their class's work, faculty see their own, admin sees all.
